**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is planning a trip to Japan.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking for affordable accommodation options.
- [PREFERENCE] The user has heard that hostels are a great way to save money but is unsure what to expect.
- [EVENT] The user is planning to visit popular tourist spots in Tokyo, such as Shibuya Crossing and Tokyo Tower.
- [TEMPORAL] The user stayed in a hostel in Tokyo last January.
- [FACT] The user mentioned that the hostel they stayed in cost around $30 per night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Staying in a hostel in Japan is a fantastic way to save money, meet fellow travelers, and experience local culture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dormitories in hostels range from ¥2,000 to ¥5,000 (around $18-$45 USD) per night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Private rooms in hostels cost between ¥5,000 to ¥10,000 (around $45-$90 USD) per night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Capsule hotels (pod hotels) cost from ¥2,000 to ¥5,000 (around $18-$45 USD) per night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Most hostels in Japan offer free Wi-Fi, shared kitchen facilities, lounge areas, laundry machines, lockers, and 24-hour reception.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some hostels may provide breakfast, linens, towels, hair dryers, toiletries, and tour bookings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Japanese hostels are known for their cleanliness and tidiness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Noise levels in hostels are generally kept low, and earplugs might be a good idea.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some hostels may have a curfew, especially in residential areas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It's a good idea to learn basic Japanese phrases for better communication.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some hostels may not allow guests with tattoos to use their facilities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can use websites like Booking.com, Hostelworld, or Japan-Guide.com to find and book hostels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can expect to pay ¥200-¥400 (around $2-$4 USD) for a single subway or train ride in Tokyo.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A 24-hour pass for the Tokyo Metro costs ¥600 (around $6 USD).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The JR Train single ride costs ¥130-¥240 (around $1.30-$2.40 USD).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Toei Bus single ride costs ¥210 (around $2 USD).
